## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Given a stack whose third node lacks a valid verdict, the merge plan lands...

The system SHALL ensure that given a stack whose third node lacks a valid verdict, the merge plan lands only the first two nodes and reports the third as blocked with its reason.

#### Scenario: Given a stack whose third node lacks a valid verdict, the merge plan lands...

WHEN `land-verified-stack-prefixes-via-gate-merge` is implemented
THEN Given a stack whose third node lacks a valid verdict, the merge plan lands only the first two nodes and reports the third as blocked with its reason.

### Requirement: Autopilot's Gate.MERGE evidence records the verified head SHA and patch-id,...

The system SHALL ensure that autopilot's Gate.MERGE evidence records the verified head SHA and patch-id, and /cleanup-feature refuses to merge when the live head's patch-id differs.

#### Scenario: Autopilot's Gate.MERGE evidence records the verified head SHA and patch-id,...

WHEN `land-verified-stack-prefixes-via-gate-merge` is implemented
THEN Autopilot's Gate.MERGE evidence records the verified head SHA and patch-id, and /cleanup-feature refuses to merge when the live head's patch-id differs.

### Requirement: Autopilot never merges on its own; the human merge gate is unchanged, and...

The system SHALL ensure that autopilot never merges on its own; the human merge gate is unchanged, and autopilot and cleanup SKILL.md edits are line-neutral or go into references/.

#### Scenario: Autopilot never merges on its own; the human merge gate is unchanged, and...

WHEN `land-verified-stack-prefixes-via-gate-merge` is implemented
THEN Autopilot never merges on its own; the human merge gate is unchanged, and autopilot and cleanup SKILL.md edits are line-neutral or go into references/.
